title: spec/plugin-detail: a field group's relatedList naming a side-card relationship saves, passes the spec and draws nothing at the group — the describe promises a body table there
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

## Observed (PR #27473, record page v3 round 2, on `main` after PR #27310 / #27215 / #27303)

`ObjectFieldGroupSchema.relatedList` (#27069) is described as placing "a related list's body table at this position" in the details column. The renderer (`bodyTablePlacement` in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`) places only lists that ARE body tables by the FK's own keys — `relatedList: 'primary'`, or a `master_detail` with `inlineEdit`. Studio's field-group inspector (`ObjectGroupInspector.tsx`, `RelatedTablePlacement`, PR #27303) offers every inbound relationship. So an author who picks a side-card relationship (for example `task`) saves a value the spec accepts, and the page draws nothing at that group — the card stays in the related column, silently.

## Reach

Named producer: Studio's group inspector (public door) and any hand-written `fieldGroups[].relatedList`. Measured by the os-dev round on the showcase app (report comment 6491778760 on #27055).

## Options (for the spec lane to rule; the seat does not)

A. Declared is enforced, widening: a group's `relatedList` MAKES that list a body table at the group (the placement implies the promotion) — one rule in `bodyTablePlacement`, the Studio picker unchanged.
B. Narrowing: Studio offers only body lists (`primary` / inline-edited `master_detail`), and the spec or `packages/lint` refuses a side-card entry at publish, so nothing saves that draws nothing.

Either way the `.describe()` must say what is enforced. Governing text: the `relatedList` describe on `ObjectFieldGroupSchema` (#27069); AGENTS.md "declared is enforced"; ruling B on #27055 (body tables by the FK's keys). Seam: `spec:ObjectFieldGroupSchema.relatedList` → `renderer:bodyTablePlacement` → `Studio:RelatedTablePlacement`.

## Dedupe words

field group relatedList side card ignored, relatedList group placement non-body, RelatedTablePlacement options, bodyTablePlacement
